Name: Photobooth
PunchlineSource: Advanced controls for portraits & adventurer plates.
PunchlineJapanese: ポートレート・アドベンチャラープレート編集を拡張します。
DescriptionSource:
Take your portrait & adventurer plate game to the next level with this companion panel for the portrait editor.

• Rewind, fast forward, and step through animations frame by frame.
• Adjust character head and eye direction without moving the camera.
• Position camera and pivot point with a top-down map.
• More intuitive controls for lighting color and angle.
DescriptionJapanese: アニメーションのコマ送り、視線・頭向き、カメラ・支点位置、照明色や角度などを細かく操作できます。

Name: PingPlugin
PunchlineSource: A ping display plugin for Dalamud.
PunchlineJapanese: 通信Pingを表示します。
DescriptionSource: A ping display plugin for Dalamud.
DescriptionJapanese: Dalamud上で現在のネットワークPingを確認できるシンプルな表示プラグインです。

Name: Pixel Perfect
PunchlineSource: Reveals your hitbox, with customisable features. Endorsed by world first raiders!
PunchlineJapanese: 自キャラの正確なヒットボックスを表示します。
DescriptionSource: Showing exactly where to stand since 2020. Endorsed by raiders!
DescriptionJapanese: 足元に当たり判定位置を描画し、ギミック回避や立ち位置調整を高精度に行いやすくします。

Name: Player Tags
PunchlineSource: Lightweight job visibility in nameplates and chat.
PunchlineJapanese: ネームプレート・チャットへ独自タグを付けます。
DescriptionSource:
Lightweight job visibility in nameplates and chat. Create custom tags and add them to players with the context menu.

You want to contribute and help developing new features or want to extend existing? Feel free to open Fork and open a Pull Request!

This plugin was originally developed by r00telement but forked and continued by Pilzinsel64.
DescriptionJapanese: プレイヤーごとにカスタムタグを作成し、右クリックメニューから割り当ててネームプレートやチャットへ表示できます。

Name: PlayerTrack
PunchlineSource: Keep track of players you meet.
PunchlineJapanese: 出会ったプレイヤーを記録・整理します。
DescriptionSource:
PlayerTrack helps you keep a record of who you meet and the content you played together.
Organize players into categories, keep notes, and track them across name/world changes.
Customization options include colors, icons, nameplates, and alerts.
DescriptionJapanese: 一緒に遊んだコンテンツ、カテゴリ、メモ、名前／ワールド変更などを追跡し、色・アイコン・通知も設定できます。

Name: 插件收纳栏
PunchlineJapanese: 他プラグインの画面・設定入口を1つにまとめます。
DescriptionSource: 把其他 Dalamud 插件的主界面/设置入口收纳到一个可选的悬浮图标栏里（支持折叠/锁定位置；并提供按 ImGui 窗口名隐藏悬浮窗、预设与分享码）。
DescriptionJapanese: 複数Dalamudプラグインのメイン画面や設定をドックへ集約し、折りたたみ、位置固定、ウィンドウ非表示、プリセット共有などを行えます。

Name: Plugin JP Helper
PunchlineSource: Dalamudプラグインの固定辞書日本語化支援
PunchlineJapanese: Dalamudプラグインの固定辞書日本語化支援
DescriptionSource: Dalamudプラグインの表示文字列を日本語化する補助プラグインです。
DescriptionJapanese: Dalamudプラグインの表示文字列を日本語化する補助プラグインです。

Name: Positional Assistant
PunchlineSource: Never guess whether you'll make that positional again!
PunchlineJapanese: 方向指定が取れる範囲をガイド表示します。
DescriptionSource: If you have a hard time telling whether you're in the right spot for positional attacks, this plugin can draw guidelines on your screen to help you tell where you need to be.
DescriptionJapanese: 側面／背面の方向指定が成立する範囲を画面へ描き、今の立ち位置で成功するか判断しやすくします。

Name: PrefPro
PunchlineSource: Changes in-game dialogue to reference your desired gender and name.
PunchlineJapanese: NPC会話内の性別・名前表現を好みに置き換えます。
DescriptionSource:
Your character is personal, so you should be able to have NPCs refer to them
the way that you want. With PrefPro, you can control which text option
will appear when an NPC uses dialogue meant for a specific in-game gender.
This allows you to use a female player model and be referred to as male, and
vice versa. In addition, there are a few name customization options - if you
want to only be referred to by your last name, so be it.
Note: This plugin currently will not swap voiced cutscene dialogue.
DescriptionJapanese: ゲーム内テキストで自キャラを指す性別表現や名前を、自分が望む形へ変更して表示します。

Name: PriceCheck
PunchlineSource: Quickly price check your items.
PunchlineJapanese: アイテムの市場価格を素早く確認します。
DescriptionSource:
To check prices, hold your keybind and then hover over an item or via the item's context menu.
The prices are pulled from the crowd-sourced site Universalis.
DescriptionJapanese: キーを押しながらアイテムへマウスオーバー、または右クリックメニューから、クラウド共有のマーケット価格を取得できます。

Name: Price Insight
PunchlineSource: See item marketboard prices on hover!
PunchlineJapanese: アイテムツールチップにマーケット価格を表示します。
DescriptionSource:
Whenever you mouseover an item, it will show you the NQ/HQ marketboard prices at the bottom as well as the most recent purchase.
Prices are retrieved from Universalis.app and cached for 90 minutes.
To refresh a price you can tap Alt while hovering over an item.
DescriptionJapanese: アイテムにカーソルを合わせるだけでNQ/HQ価格と最近の取引価格をツールチップへ表示します。

Name: Prioritizer
PunchlineSource: Prioritizer sets game's priority to high while crafting.
PunchlineJapanese: 製作中だけFFXIVのプロセス優先度を上げます。
DescriptionSource: Prioritizer sets game's priority to high while crafting. No more failed crafts due to random lags while game is minimized.
DescriptionJapanese: ゲームを最小化していても処理落ちで製作を失敗しにくいよう、製作中にプロセス優先度をHighへ変更します。

Name: ProxyPlayer
PunchlineSource: Control what's playing on your computer within XIV!
PunchlineJapanese: ゲーム内からPCのメディア再生を操作します。
DescriptionSource:
ProxyPlayer is a simple plugin that allows you to control your computer's media playback from within XIV.

Control your media player from within the game, without having to alt-tab or use a second monitor.
Features (depending on your media player):
- Play/Pause
- Next/Previous Track
- Stop
- Progress Bar
- Cover Art Display
- Metadata

ProxyPlayer comes with either a compact or portrait UI for displaying your media information.
DescriptionJapanese: FFXIV内でWindows上の音楽・動画プレイヤーを再生／一時停止／次へ等操作できます。

Name: Pseudonamingway
PunchlineSource: Give Mendingway and Vendingway the respect they deserve!
PunchlineJapanese: 一部ロポリットの名前表示を変更します。
DescriptionSource: [English only] A plugin to give various loporrits their correct names.
DescriptionJapanese: MendingwayやVendingwayなどの名前を別表記へ変更する英語クライアント向けネタ系プラグインです。

Name: PT Battle Log
PunchlineSource: ID単位で回復・蘇生・状態異常解除をリアルタイム集計します。
PunchlineJapanese: ID単位で回復・蘇生・状態異常解除をリアルタイム集計します。
DescriptionSource: 自分の所属PTを対象に、DPS・回復・被ダメージ・蘇生・状態異常解除をリアルタイム集計し、戦闘ログ・比較・履歴・周回記録を表示します。
DescriptionJapanese: 自分の所属PTを対象に、DPS・回復・被ダメージ・蘇生・状態異常解除をリアルタイム集計し、戦闘ログ・比較・履歴・周回記録を表示します。

Name: PullToOBS
PunchlineSource: Automated OBS recording manager for FFXIV encounters.
PunchlineJapanese: 戦闘に合わせてOBS録画を自動制御します。
DescriptionSource: A Dalamud plugin that automatically controls OBS recording during FFXIV encounters. Captures replay buffer before pulls and full encounter recordings via OBS WebSocket v5. Supports quick-save hotkey for on-demand replay buffer clips. Use /pulltoobs or /pto to configure.
DescriptionJapanese: FFXIVの戦闘開始・終了を検知してOBS録画やリプレイバッファ保存を自動化します。

Name: PushyFinder
PunchlineSource: Mobile push notifications for the Party Finder.
PunchlineJapanese: パーティ募集をスマホ等へプッシュ通知します。
DescriptionSource: A plugin that uses Pushover (https://pushover.net), Discord, SimplePush (http://simplepush.io), or Ntfy (https://ntfy.sh) to send mobile push notifications when party members join or leave, or when a duty finder queue is initiated.
DescriptionJapanese: Pushover、Discord、SimplePush、ntfy等を使い、指定条件のパーティ募集を外部端末へ通知します。

Name: NPCAnnouncer
PunchlineSource: Do you want an announcer in your PvP matches, PvE duties, and fates? Metem and the Scions have offered their services!
PunchlineJapanese: 戦闘イベントにキャラクターボイスを付けます。
DescriptionSource: This plugin will cause character voice lines to play upon specific conditions being met.
DescriptionJapanese: PvP、PvE、FATEなどで特定条件を満たした時に、メテムや暁メンバー等のボイスラインを再生します。

Name: PvP Tracker
PunchlineSource: PvP match history and stats tracker.
PunchlineJapanese: PvPの試合履歴・統計を記録します。
DescriptionSource: Record, browse and filter your Crystalline Conflict, Frontline and Rival Wings match history, view match scoreboards and view aggregated statistics like win rate and average damage dealt per match.
DescriptionJapanese: クリスタルコンフリクト、フロントライン、ライバルウィングズの履歴・スコア・集計統計を保存・閲覧できます。

Name: QoL Bar
PunchlineSource: Customizable ImGui hotbars
PunchlineJapanese: 自由に作れるImGuiホットバーです。
DescriptionSource:
A plugin designed to provide a simple, customizable and always available interface for chat commands
or other plugins to alleviate the need for using macros and hotbar space to achieve similar results.

The plugin should initially appear as a small box on the bottom center of the game window.
DescriptionJapanese: チャットコマンドや他プラグイン操作をボタン化し、常時使えるカスタムホットバーとして配置できます。

Name: QuestAWAY
PunchlineSource: Removes unwanted icons from your map.
PunchlineJapanese: 地図上の不要なアイコンを非表示にします。
DescriptionSource: Removes unwanted icons from your map. Not only quests, any icons.
DescriptionJapanese: クエストに限らず、指定した種類のマップアイコンを隠して地図をすっきりさせます。

Name: Questionable
PunchlineSource: A tiny quest helper plugin.
PunchlineJapanese: クエスト進行を可能な範囲で自動化します。
DescriptionSource:
A small quest helper plugin designed to automatically do your quests for you where possible. Utilizes navmesh to automatically travel to all quest waypoints and (attempts to) complete all steps along the way (excluding dungeons, single-player duties and combat).

Not all quests are supported.

Required Plugins: vnavmesh, TextAdvance, Lifestream
DescriptionJapanese: 小型クエストヘルパーとして、vnavmeshを使った移動や会話などを自動実行し、対応クエストを進めます。

Name: QuestJournal
PunchlineSource: See details about quests that the FFXIV doesn't tell you.
PunchlineJapanese: クエストの詳細・関連情報を表示します。
DescriptionSource: Quest Journal is a detailed quest tracker / viewer. Letting you see information about quest chains without using a wiki.
DescriptionJapanese: ゲーム内で見えにくいクエストチェーンや前後関係などを、Wikiを開かず確認できる詳細トラッカーです。

Name: Quest Map
PunchlineSource: Explore quests and their rewards.
PunchlineJapanese: クエストと報酬を検索・可視化します。
DescriptionSource:
Explore quests and their rewards.
- Search for quest names or their rewards, including instances,
  beast tribes, minions, etc.
- See an interactive map of quest requirements and unlocks.
- Open a quest info window even for quests you haven't completed.
- Open quest starting locations on the map or open quests in the journal.

Icons: treasure map by Anthony Ledoux from the Noun Project and
locked book by Anthony Ledoux from the Noun Project
DescriptionJapanese: クエスト名や報酬から検索し、関連コンテンツ、友好部族、ミニオン等を含む進行関係を調べられます。

Name: Quest Share
PunchlineSource: Share your quest progress with others.
PunchlineJapanese: フレンドとクエスト進捗を共有します。
DescriptionSource: Follow your friends on their questing journey by seeing their progress through a shared quest. Provides markers for quest destinations and (soon) teleporting features.
DescriptionJapanese: 同じクエストを進める相手の進行状況や目的地マーカーを共有し、一緒に進めやすくします。

Name: QuestTracker
PunchlineSource: For the quest completionist
PunchlineJapanese: クエスト完了状況を追跡します。
DescriptionSource: Easily track quest completion
DescriptionJapanese: クエストコンプリートを目指す人向けに、完了・未完了を分かりやすく管理します。

Name: QuickSymbols
PunchlineSource: Adds a quick special-symbol picker beside the chat mode button.
PunchlineJapanese: チャット入力欄に特殊記号ピッカーを追加します。
DescriptionSource: Adds a Quick Symbols button beside the chat mode selector and other text inputs.
DescriptionJapanese: チャットモード選択付近などへボタンを追加し、FFXIVで使える特殊記号を簡単に入力できます。

Name: Quiet The Den
PunchlineSource: Stop yer ears bleedin' in the Wolves' Den
PunchlineJapanese: ウルヴズジェイル係船場でBGMを自動ミュートします。
DescriptionSource: Auto-mute BGM while in the Wolves' Den, because I've had enough and it ends here.
DescriptionJapanese: ウルヴズジェイル内にいる間だけBGMを自動で消音します。

Name: Racingway
PunchlineSource: Time your jumping puzzles!
PunchlineJapanese: ジャンピングアスレチックのタイムを計測します。
DescriptionSource: A simple plugin for timing, logging, and ranking player times for your jumping puzzles!
DescriptionJapanese: ジャンピングパズルの所要時間を計測・保存し、プレイヤー間の記録をランキング表示できます。

Name: Random Class Selector
PunchlineSource: Can't decide what class to work on today? Let the plugin decide for you!
PunchlineJapanese: 今日育てるクラス／ジョブをランダム選択します。
DescriptionSource: Allows you to select a random class to do dailies/etc on.
DescriptionJapanese: デイリーなどでどのクラスを使うか迷った時、候補からランダムに1つ選びます。

Name: Raphael.Dalamud
PunchlineSource: Dalamud Wrapper for Craft Solver Raphael / 生产求解器 Raphael 的 Dalamud 包装
PunchlineJapanese: 製作ソルバーRaphaelをDalamud連携します。
DescriptionSource:
Dalamud Wrapper for Craft Solver Raphael / 生产求解器 Raphael 的 Dalamud 包装
Mainly used to provide IPC for other Dalamud plugins / 主要用于提供 IPC 给其他 Dalamud 插件调用
DescriptionJapanese: Craft Solver RaphaelのDalamudラッパーで、主に他プラグインから利用するIPC機能を提供します。

Name: Battery Buddy
PunchlineSource: Display the battery level of your wireless Razer and Logitech devices
PunchlineJapanese: Razer/Logitech無線機器のバッテリーを表示します。
DescriptionSource:
Automatically pull device battery levels and display them in a configurable number of ways!

Currently supported brands:
- Razer
- Logitech
DescriptionJapanese: 対応ワイヤレスデバイスの残量を取得し、ゲーム内へ複数形式で表示します。

Name: Ready Check Helper
PunchlineSource: Extends the game's built-in ready check.
PunchlineJapanese: レディチェック結果を詳しく表示します。
DescriptionSource: Displays the names of the players that were not ready in chat following the completion of a ready check, and optionally adds ready check status icons over the party and alliance lists.
DescriptionJapanese: レディチェック終了後に未準備だったメンバー名をチャット表示し、追加の状態表示も設定できます。

Name: RealTorch
PunchlineSource: Set the world alight!
PunchlineJapanese: 松明系アクセサリーを実際に発光させます。
DescriptionSource: Makes the torch accessory put out light.
DescriptionJapanese: トーチ形状のファッションアクセサリーなどから周囲を照らす光源を出す演出を追加します。

Name: Reborn Toolbox
PunchlineSource: Let that sink in!
PunchlineJapanese: Combat Reborn系の細かな便利機能をまとめます。
DescriptionSource: Various tweaks and features provided by the Combat Reborn team that don't need their own plugin
DescriptionJapanese: 単独プラグインにするほどではない各種Tweaksや補助機能をまとめたツールボックスです。

Name: rec-cue
PunchlineSource: Recording activity indicator.
PunchlineJapanese: 録画中らしい状態をゲーム内表示します。
DescriptionSource: A Dalamud plugin that monitors a configurable folder for recording file activity and shows an in-game [Rec] indicator when capture is likely active. Use /reccue to configure.
DescriptionJapanese: 指定フォルダーの録画ファイル更新を監視し、キャプチャが行われている時に[Rec]インジケーターを表示します。

Name: Redirect
PunchlineSource: Simple mouseover and ground-targeting action integration
PunchlineJapanese: マウスオーバー・グラウンド指定アクションの対象優先度を調整します。
DescriptionSource: Easily change the targeting priority for spells and abilities. Queue macros and ground-targeted actions! Type /redirect to configure.
DescriptionJapanese: アクションごとにターゲット優先順位を変更し、マクロキューや地面指定アクションも扱いやすくします。/redirect で設定します。

Name: Remote Party Finder Uploader
PunchlineSource: Crowdsourced PF website (upload PF listings to xivpf.com)
PunchlineJapanese: 取得したパーティ募集をxivpf.comへ共有します。
DescriptionSource: Uploads the PF listings you retrieve to the crowdsourced Remote Party Finder website (https://xivpf.com/).
DescriptionJapanese: ゲーム内で取得したParty Finder一覧をクラウド型Remote Party Finderサイトへアップロードします。

Name: RepairMe
PunchlineSource: Never forget to repair & extract materia again!
PunchlineJapanese: 修理・マテリア精製忘れを知らせます。
DescriptionSource: Helps you notice when your gear needs to be repaired or has materia to be extracted.
DescriptionJapanese: 装備耐久が低い時や錬精度100%でマテリア精製できる時に分かりやすく通知します。

Name: ReSanctuary
PunchlineSource: Improve your Island Sanctuary experience.
PunchlineJapanese: 無人島開拓の採集・作業を支援します。
DescriptionSource:
A plugin to improve Island Sanctuary. Features:

- Mark items to gather on the proper map
- Gathering & crafting todo-list, showing you what mats you require
- Widget for quick access to information

Icon from the Mutant Standard project.
DescriptionJapanese: 採集対象の地図表示、採集・製作TODO、その他無人島向け便利機能を提供します。

Name: Resizable HUD
PunchlineSource: Move and scale vanilla hud elements to your liking!
PunchlineJapanese: 標準HUD要素をより自由に移動・拡縮します。
DescriptionSource: Allows you to more freely and precisely scale and position HUD elements.
DescriptionJapanese: ゲーム標準HUDを通常より細かい単位で位置調整・サイズ変更できます。

Name: ResLogger2.Plugin
PunchlineSource: A path logger with optional crowdsourcing functionality.
PunchlineJapanese: ゲームが読み込むパスを記録します。
DescriptionSource:
ResLogger2 allows you to log paths that the game loads in a fast and convenient
window, with multiple options including only logging unique paths, path filters,
and uploading found paths. Information on the crowdsourced paths is available
at https://rl2.perchbird.dev.
Open the UI with /reslog.
DescriptionJapanese: モデル等のリソースパスを高速にログ表示し、重複除外や任意のクラウド共有にも対応する調査ツールです。

Name: Res Stack Counter
PunchlineSource: Utility for hosts in Forked Tower runs.
PunchlineJapanese: Forked Tower主催向けPT情報を一覧表示します。
DescriptionSource: List various information about nearby players such as Phantom Job, Remaining Resurrection Stacks in Forked Towers, as well as Knowledge Level. Use /ressc [settings] to open the main or settings window.
DescriptionJapanese: 周囲プレイヤーのファントムジョブ、蘇生スタック、知識レベル等を一覧化し、塔攻略の主催・管理を支援します。

Name: Restore Camera Pivot While Auto-Running
PunchlineSource: Restore legacy camera pivot while auto-running.
PunchlineJapanese: オートラン中だけ旧式カメラ支点を復元します。
DescriptionSource:
Temporarily restores legacy camera pivot while auto-running.
Only affects Legacy Type movement with Disable camera pivot enabled.
DescriptionJapanese: レガシー移動＋カメラ支点無効設定時、オートラン中だけ従来のカメラピボット挙動へ一時的に戻します。

Name: Retainer Alerts
PunchlineSource: Reminds you about retainer ventures.
PunchlineJapanese: リテイナーベンチャー完了を通知します。
DescriptionSource: A simple plugin to remind you when your retainers are done with their ventures.
DescriptionJapanese: リテイナーの探索依頼が完了した時に知らせるシンプルなリマインダーです。

Name: RetainerReach
PunchlineSource: Unified retainer inventory grid with one-click retrieve. Requires AllaganTools.
PunchlineJapanese: 全リテイナー所持品を1画面で検索・取り出します。
DescriptionSource: REQUIRES AllaganTools (a.k.a. Allagan Market / InventoryTools) installed and enabled — RetainerReach reads your retainer inventories from it. Unified view of your active character and all retainers' inventories as an in-game-style icon grid, with one-click Retrieve that summons each holding retainer at a nearby Summoning Bell and pulls selected items into your bags. Search by name, filter by category or crafting material, save recurring pulls as presets, and retrieve from chat via /retrieve. This plugin automates in-game actions (retainer bell interaction and item retrieval) on your behalf; use at your own risk with respect to the game's Terms of Service.
DescriptionJapanese: Allagan Toolsのデータを使い、複数リテイナーの所持品を統合グリッド表示し、目的アイテムをワンクリックで取り出しやすくします。

Name: Retainer Sales
PunchlineSource: See retainer sales quicker
PunchlineJapanese: ログアウト中のリテイナー販売を素早く確認します。
DescriptionSource: Quickly see which retainers have sold something while you were logged off.
DescriptionJapanese: 再ログイン後にどのリテイナーが何かを売ったかを一覧で確認しやすくします。

Name: Rezo Scale Plugin
PunchlineSource: Lower 3D Resolution Scale
PunchlineJapanese: 3D描画解像度スケールをさらに下げます。
DescriptionSource:
Ever wanted to render at lower resolution? Now you can!
Only works with AMD FSR graphics upscaler
DescriptionJapanese: AMD FSR利用時に標準より低い内部解像度で描画でき、GPU負荷軽減を狙えます。

Name: RezPls
PunchlineSource: Highlighting of Raises and detrimental status effects.
PunchlineJapanese: 蘇生・解除可能デバフを見やすく表示します。
DescriptionSource:
Easy overview about who is currently resurrecting who,
who is already resurrected,
and who has removable detrimental status effects in the world 
as well as in the group or alliance interface.
DescriptionJapanese: 誰が誰を蘇生中か、蘇生済みか、解除可能な有害ステータスがあるかを一覧で把握しやすくします。

Name: RPP - Roleplay Profiles
PunchlineSource: Display profiles from Chaos Archives, Crystal Archives, and Central Archives in-game
PunchlineJapanese: 外部RPプロフィールをゲーム内表示します。
DescriptionSource: A plugin for roleplayers, displaying character profiles from Central Archives (centralarchives.org) and its regional RP portals, Chaos Archives (chaosarchives.org) and Crystal Archives (crystalarchives.org), for characters with the RP flag on.
DescriptionJapanese: Central/Chaos/Crystal Archivesなどに登録されたキャラクターRPプロフィールをゲーム内から閲覧できます。

Name: Rotation Solver Reborn
PunchlineSource: Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.
PunchlineJapanese: 戦闘状況を解析して次の最適アクションを提案します。
DescriptionSource:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.
DescriptionJapanese: 毎フレームの戦闘情報を分析し、現在のジョブ状態や敵状況から適切な次アクションを判断します。

Name: Seated Sidekick Spectator

Name: Shanbells
PunchlineSource: Bringing Shananigans to Eorzea
PunchlineJapanese: 「Gil」など通貨名の表示を好きな語へ置き換えます。

DescriptionJapanese: 通貨ウィンドウやツールチップの「Gil」をShanbellsなど任意の文字列へ変更するネタ系プラグインです。

Name: Shop Item Icons
PunchlineSource: Displays item icons instead of item category icons in shops.
PunchlineJapanese: ショップの商品カテゴリ表示をアイテムアイコンへ置き換えます。
DescriptionSource:
Displays item icons instead of item category icons in shops.
      
Supported windows:

- Shops: Simple merchants that sell items for Gil.
- Item Exchange: Vendors that trade items for items, such as the Wolf Collar Exchange or Itinerant Moogles that exchange items for Irregular Tomestones during the Moogle Treasure Trove event.

DescriptionJapanese: 撮影時にキャラクター名、マップ名、座標などをファイル名へ付けます。標準、ReShade、GShadeのスクリーンショット監視に対応します。

Name: SillyChat

PunchlineJapanese: チャットを海賊風・ウリエンジェ風などに変換します。

DescriptionJapanese: プレイヤー／NPCチャットや吹き出しを、海賊、ウリエンジェ、Leet、Pig Latin、モーグリ等の遊び言語へ変換します。

DescriptionJapanese: チャット等の文字列をトリガーに、チャット応答、トースト、音など任意の通知・処理を実行できます。

Name: Simple Tweaks Plugin
PunchlineSource: This was supposed to be simple...

A collection of Quality of Life tweaks. Aiming to improve the experience without changing anything drastically.

DescriptionJapanese: ゲーム性を大きく変えない細かな便利機能を多数収録し、すべて個別にON/OFFできます。

PunchlineSource: See chat messages from your current target in a separate window.
PunchlineJapanese: 現在ターゲットの発言だけを別窓表示します。

DescriptionJapanese: ゲーム内の文字表示効果音やクイックチャット音をミュートして、静かなプレイ環境にします。

Name: Sound Filter

PunchlineJapanese: 任意のゲームサウンドをフィルターします。

DescriptionJapanese: 特定の戦闘音、エモート音など、指定したゲーム音を個別に非再生へできます。

Name: Splatoon
PunchlineSource: Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time
PunchlineJapanese: ギミック・マーカー等を描画できるスクリプト式オーバーレイです。
DescriptionSource:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!
DescriptionJapanese: リアルタイム3D描画エンジンとして、AoE、位置、マーカー、攻略補助表示などをスクリプトで自由に描画できます。

DescriptionJapanese: 公式インストーラー外で手動配置したプラグインについて、導入・アップデート作業を簡略化します。

Name: Stanley Parable XIV
PunchlineSource: Witty commentary to the brilliant things you do.

PunchlineSource: 关闭屏蔽词过滤，并高亮聊天和招募板里的屏蔽词。 Disable word-filter blocking and highlight filtered words in chat and Party Finder.
PunchlineJapanese: 禁止語フィルターを解除し該当語を強調します。

DescriptionJapanese: 明るい背景でもバフ／デバフの残り時間が読めるよう、アイコン表示へコントラストを追加します。

Name: StatusTimers

PunchlineJapanese: バフ・デバフをカスタムバーで追跡します。

DescriptionJapanese: 重要なステータスの残り時間を見やすいバーで表示し、条件や見た目を細かく設定できます。

Name: Steam Recording Enhanced
PunchlineSource: Add various in-game events to your Steam Game Recording timeline, comes with instructions for non-steam users!
PunchlineJapanese: Steam録画タイムラインへゲームイベントを追加します。
DescriptionSource:
Enhance Steam Game Recording by automatically adding configurable in-game events to the timeline, allowing for easy rewinding and clipping. Rewind to the moment of your death to reassure yourself that you did dodge the AOE before it went off and that the game does hate you personally with greater efficiency than ever!

Non-steam users will have to follow a setup guide located in the configuration's window Status tab to get everything working.
DescriptionJapanese: Steam Game Recordingのタイムラインにコンテンツ開始等のイベントを自動記録し、後から目的場面へ戻りやすくします。

Name: Sticky Focus Target
PunchlineSource: Like /focustarget, but with no overrides.
PunchlineJapanese: 既存フォーカスを上書きしないフォーカスターゲットを追加します。
DescriptionSource:
(PvE-only.) Adds the /stickyfocustarget command, which focuses your current
target, as long as you do not already have a focus target set.
  
Have you ever felt focusing was under-utilised? Wanted to use it without a
dedicated keybind? Do you not even know what focus targeting is?
You've come to the right place.
  
You can add this command to your Attack Nearest macro and ensure that the
first enemy you target will also become focused, and stay that way, until it dies.
With this, you can focus enemies without having to consciously press a keybind,
and ensure that, for instance, when a focused boss spawns an add and you target it,
the boss' focus will NOT get overriden.

This plugin does not change the behaviour of the stock /focustarget command,
and must be triggered either manually or by adding it to a macro.
Placeholders are supported.
DescriptionJapanese: PvEで、フォーカスターゲットが未設定の時だけ現在ターゲットをフォーカスする /stickyfocustarget コマンドを追加します。

Name: Stormtalons

PunchlineSource: An expanded and extremely customizable rewrite of the in-game term filter, this allows players to mask/hide/modify messages containing specific words.
PunchlineJapanese: 標準禁止語フィルターを大幅に拡張します。
DescriptionSource:
I felt like the vanilla term filter was missing a lot of options, so I added them.
"If the term filter is so good, why didn't they make a term filter 2?"
DescriptionJapanese: ゲーム内の単語フィルターをより柔軟に書き換え、独自条件や表示方法を細かく設定できます。

Name: TextAdvance汉化版
PunchlineSource: Quest speedrunning assistance tool. Automatically skips subtitle boxes and confirms cutscene skipping
PunchlineJapanese: 会話送り・確認を自動化するクエスト高速化支援です。
DescriptionSource:
任务速通辅助工具。自动跳过字幕框、自动确认过场动画跳过。

Quest speedrunning assistance tool. Automatically skips subtitle boxes and confirms cutscene skipping.
DescriptionJapanese:
自動スキップは字幕棒を通過し、自動的にアニメーション アートを通過します。

クエスト スピードランニング支援ツール。字幕ボックスを自動的にスキップし、カットシーンのスキップを確認します。

Name: TextToTalk
PunchlineSource: Chat and game dialogue TTS plugin.
PunchlineJapanese: チャット・ゲーム会話をTTSで読み上げます。
DescriptionSource: Chat and game dialogue TTS. Use /tttconfig to configure the enabled channels and triggers/exceptions.
DescriptionJapanese: 指定したチャットチャンネルや会話を音声合成で読み上げます。/tttconfig で対象や例外を設定します。

Name: Hit it, Joe! (Formerly TF2-ish Critical Hits Plugin)
PunchlineSource: Configure sounds for critical and direct hits, plus some countdown music.
PunchlineJapanese: クリティカル／DH時の音・演出を変更します。
DescriptionSource:
* Set sounds and flavor text to be played/shown whenever you deal direct or critical damage or heal.
* Set sounds to be played when a countdown is in progress.
* Use different configurations by job.
* Use the game's SFX or your own custom WAV or MP3 files.
DescriptionJapanese: クリティカル・ダイレクトヒット・回復時に任意サウンドやテキストを再生し、カウントダウン音楽も設定できます。

Name: The Collector
PunchlineSource: Plugin that automatically turns in collectables and buys specified scrip items
PunchlineJapanese: 収集品納品とスクリップ交換を自動化します。
DescriptionSource: Automates collectable turn-ins and automatically purchases specified items when reaching scrip caps. Integrates with GatherBuddyReborn and Artisan, allowing you to create perfect loops of gathering, crafting, and turn-ins.
DescriptionJapanese: 収集品を自動納品し、スクリップ上限に近づくと指定アイテムを自動購入します。採集系プラグインとの連携もあります。

Name: The Heart of the Party
PunchlineSource: Set your character's title - now with Searchalin!
PunchlineJapanese: 検索対応の称号選択UIを追加します。
DescriptionSource:
The Heart of the Party is a remake of the in-game title picker, but it
supports searching. Note that it doesn't add a command to set your title; use
the built-in /title command instead.
DescriptionJapanese: 標準の称号選択画面を使いやすく再構成し、称号名検索を追加します。

Name: Things To Do In Eorzea
PunchlineSource: Unsure what to do? Forgot what you wanted to do? Nonsense! There's always things to do in Eorzea!
PunchlineJapanese: エオルゼアでやることをまとめて管理します。
DescriptionSource:
Keep track of all your objectives and tasks in Eorzea. Whether it's collecting tomes/items/gear, completing dungeons/trials/raids, FATEs, or purely making a random list of things to do to keep yourself busy, keep yourself organized and on track with this plugin.

Features:
    - Create and manage a list of objectives and tasks.
    - Automatically track your progress on objectives and tasks.
    - View your objectives and tasks with a window inspired by the in-game Duty Log.
    - Automatic translation of objectives and tasks to your game client's language. (No need to write what you want to do. Just setup how you want to do it and the plugin will fill in the rest!)
    - Open creativity for just about anything that comes up to mine! (...What? You don't think making silly challenges like doing Endsinger's Aria - Extreme with MINE in under 12 minutes a good idea? Seriously, you can make that a task if you want)
       
Inspired by the idea of "DYOM" (Design Your Own Mission) and "TTDISA" (Things To Do In San Andreas) from GTA: San Andreas as well as Simple To-Do List and other similar plugins.
DescriptionJapanese: トークン、アイテム、装備、ダンジョン等の目標・TODOを一覧で追跡し、忘れず進められるようにします。

Name: Tick Tracker
PunchlineSource: Tracks the current tick for HP/MP/GP regen
PunchlineJapanese: HP/MP/GP自然回復のティックを表示します。
DescriptionSource: Customizable bars that indicate the tick progress of HP/MP/GP regen
DescriptionJapanese: 自然回復が発生する周期をカスタムバーで表示し、次の回復タイミングを把握しやすくします。

Name: Tidy Chat
PunchlineSource: Cut down FFXIV chat spam with per-message toggles and shorter system lines.
PunchlineJapanese: システムメッセージ等のチャット量を減らします。
DescriptionSource:
Trim the messages FFXIV dumps into your chat log.

  - Toggles for currencies, FC and retainer messages, level-ups, mount unlocks, orchestrion lines, deep dungeon pomanders, combat log categories, and more
  - Shorter rewrites for instance entry, commendations, Novice Network, and treasure dungeon text
  - Copies /say quest dialogue to your clipboard; can block emote spam from others
  - Player whitelist, chat history deduplication, per-tomestone hides, and debug logging
DescriptionJapanese: System、Progress、Loot、Obtained、Crafting等の各種メッセージを個別に短縮・非表示にし、チャットを整理します。

Name: Tilted
PunchlineSource: Tilt the camera, not yourself.
PunchlineJapanese: 条件に応じてカメラ角度・距離を自動調整します。
DescriptionSource: Automatically adjusts the Third Person Camera Angle/Distance given certain conditions.
DescriptionJapanese: 三人称カメラの角度や距離を、状況別ルールに従って自動的に変更します。

Name: Tippy
PunchlineSource: Tippy, your new FFXIV virtual assistant.
PunchlineJapanese: Tippyという仮想アシスタントを追加します。
DescriptionSource:
Developed by goat for April Fools 2021 and unnecessarily resurrected by kal and adopted by Critical-Impact.

Handcrafted by our finest code artisans with special AI, 
he will analyze your playstyle to give you useful tips to get your GAMING to the next level.

Some things he can do:
* He can give general tips about the game
* He can give tips about the job you're playing
* He can report on your battle performance
* He will respect your feelings
DescriptionJapanese: FFXIV内にジョーク的なバーチャルアシスタントを表示する、エイプリルフール由来のプラグインです。

Name: Title Edit
PunchlineSource: Create, share, and shuffle custom title and character select screens for FFXIV.
PunchlineJapanese: タイトル／キャラ選択画面を自由に作成・共有します。
DescriptionSource:
Create your own custom title or character select screen of your favorite location in-game, and open the game right up to that spot every time.
Includes a number of preinstalled title and character select screen presets for you to use or get inspiration from, and an easy to use importer to use presets that others have shared!
Character select presets support recording your last visited location, per character display setting and even displaying yourself on a mount.
DescriptionJapanese: ゲーム内のお気に入り場所などを使って独自タイトル画面・キャラクター選択画面を作成し、保存・共有・ランダム表示できます。

DescriptionJapanese: 新規入手アイテム、クリスタル、ギルなどを画面トーストで分かりやすく通知します。

Name: TopSellingItems
PunchlineSource: Find cross-DC market opportunities.
PunchlineJapanese: DC間マーケット価格差を探します。

PunchlineJapanese: 全ジョブレベル合計を表示します。

DescriptionJapanese: クラス／ジョブ画面へ、現在キャラクターの全ジョブレベル合計値を追加表示します。

Name: Total Level
PunchlineSource: Sums up all "skill" levels like that one classic MMORPG
PunchlineJapanese: キャラクターの総レベルを検索情報へ表示します。
DescriptionSource: Shows the total level of a Character in the Search Info panel
DescriptionJapanese: 各クラス／ジョブのレベルを合計した「Total Level」をキャラクター検索情報パネルへ表示します。

Name: Tourist
PunchlineSource: Finish your sightseeing log.
PunchlineJapanese: 探検手帳の達成を支援します。
DescriptionSource:
Tourist adds a window to assist with the sightseeing log.

- Show when sightseeing log vistas are available
- Add markers for ARR vistas
- Open vista locations on your map
- Hide already completed or unavailable vistas

"sightseeing" icon by muhammad, from thenounproject.com CC BY 3.0
DescriptionJapanese: 各ビスタの出現可能時間、位置マーカーなどを表示し、探検手帳を埋めやすくします。

Name: TPie
PunchlineSource: Customizable ring-shaped hotbars
PunchlineJapanese: リング型のカスタムホットバーを追加します。

DescriptionJapanese: キーで呼び出せる円形ホットバーにアクション、アイテム、ギアセット、マクロ等を自由に登録できます。

Name: Tracky
PunchlineSource: Tracking data is fun
PunchlineJapanese: 通貨・テレポ費用など各種データを記録します。

### Normal Functions

+ Track desynthesis results
+ Track retainer ventures

### Advanced  Functions

  - Venture Coffer

  - Materiel Container 4.0

+ Track Eureka/Bozja lockboxes
DescriptionJapanese: 通貨増減、テレポ／修理費、分解結果など多様なゲーム内数値を継続的に追跡します。

Name: TradeVendor
PunchlineSource: 複数トレード累積払い対応の自動取引プラグイン（試作版）
PunchlineJapanese: 複数トレード累積払い対応の自動取引プラグイン（試作版）
DescriptionSource:
TradeVendor は FFXIV のトレードを自動化するプラグインです（試作版）。

■ 3つの動作モード
- 通常自動承認: トレード画面が開いたら自動で承認
- 自動販売機モード: 相手が提示したアイテムを登録ルールと照合し、条件一致でギルを払って自動取引
- 青燐水バレル自動取引(Toka): 複数トレードをまたいで累積支払いを管理。1回の上限100万Gを超える分は逆トレードで残額を自動清算

■ 特徴
- 取引対象アイテムを検索して選択可能（既定: 青燐水バレル）
- 取引相手の自動検知・取引成立判定がクライアント言語に依存しない
- 設定(DefaultConfig.json)とセッション状態(SessionState.json)を分離して管理

■ コマンド
/tradevendor — 設定画面を開く

※ 試作版です。動作未保証の機能が含まれます。

DescriptionSource: Tracks weekly raid lockout, tomestones, gear, and other miscellaneous things.
DescriptionJapanese: 週次レイドロック、トークン、装備などの進捗をまとめて管理します。

PunchlineSource: [For plugin developers only] A plugin that clears off load and unload errors.
PunchlineJapanese: 開発者向けにプラグインLoad/Unloadエラーを消去します。

PunchlineJapanese: コンテンツごとにボイス言語を自動変更します。
DescriptionSource: Changes your VO language by specifying a language and an instance, your language will revert to the default when you exit. Icon designed by Leremy from Flaticon
DescriptionJapanese: 指定インスタンスへ入った時だけ音声言語を切り替え、退出後は通常設定へ戻します。

Name: Satisfier
PunchlineSource: Simplify custom deliveries.
PunchlineJapanese: お得意様取引を自動化します。
DescriptionSource: Make custom deliveries less annoying by automating the process.
DescriptionJapanese: カスタムデリバリーの選択・納品などの繰り返し操作を簡略化・自動化します。

Name: WachuMakeyMaking?
PunchlineSource: A mod that calculates what you can do with what you have.
PunchlineJapanese: 手持ち素材から作れる最適な組み合わせを計算します。
DescriptionSource: WachuMakeyMaking takes what you have in your inventory and calculates the optimal combination of items to make. Item prices are fetched from Universalis, or can be manually overridden.
DescriptionJapanese: インベントリ内容を読み取り、現在の素材から作れるアイテムの組み合わせや価値を計算します。

Name: Waitingway
PunchlineSource: Set out for Dawntrail and make your queues a breeze. Waitingway provides crowdsourced FFXIV login queue times, now with Discord queue notification features.
PunchlineJapanese: ログイン・CF待ち時間を共有データで予測します。
DescriptionSource:
Contributes and utilizes crowdsourced login, duty, and roulette queue information for the benefit of everyone.

Current features include queue time estimates and notifications via Discord, so you can know when you make it into the game, as well as anonymously collecting and reporting statistics about your queue times to crowdsource information about FFXIV server load and activity. Join our Discord for more information!

Discord URL: https://waiting.camora.dev/discord
DescriptionJapanese: クラウド共有されたログイン待機、コンテンツ、ルーレット待ち時間情報を送受信し、待ち時間の目安を表示します。

Name: Wave Wrangler
PunchlineSource: Never mess up your wave emoticon again!
PunchlineJapanese: 「o/」の誤入力を自動修正します。
DescriptionSource: Literally all this plugin does is send "o/" in chat if you accidentally type "/o"
DescriptionJapanese: チャットで誤って /o と入力した場合に、挨拶の「o/」として送信するだけのシンプルな補助です。

Name: Waymark Preset Plugin
PunchlineSource: Improved Waymark Management
PunchlineJapanese: フィールドマーカープリセットを無制限管理します。
DescriptionSource: Allows you to save, edit, place, import, export, and preview an unlimited number of waymark presets.
DescriptionJapanese: マーカー構成を保存・編集・設置・インポート・エクスポート・プレビューできます。

Name: Weatherman
PunchlineSource: Allows precise control over time and weather per zone or globally.
PunchlineJapanese: エリアごとの時間・天候をローカル変更します。
DescriptionJapanese: ゾーン別または全体でゲーム内時刻・天候を自由に変更し、時間停止等も行えます。

Name: WeathermanExtras
PunchlineSource: Experimental Weatherman functions.
PunchlineJapanese: Weathermanの実験機能を追加します。
DescriptionSource: Experimental Weatherman functions. Use at your own risk.
DescriptionJapanese: Weatherman向けの未完成・実験的機能を提供します。使用は自己責任です。

Name: Say What?
PunchlineSource: Persistent NPC Flavor Text
PunchlineJapanese: NPCの吹き出し台詞をチャットログへ残します。
DescriptionSource: Prints NPC speech bubbles to the chat log.  Please check the plugin settings and your chat log filters to make sure that they are compatible with each other.
DescriptionJapanese: 画面上だけで消えるNPCのフレーバーテキストをチャットへ出力し、後から読み返せるようにします。

Name: Where am I again?
PunchlineSource: Shows what zone/region/territory you are in next to the server info.
PunchlineJapanese: 現在のゾーン／地域／テリトリーを表示します。
DescriptionSource: Shows what zone/region/territory you are in up in the corner next to the server and time info. Open config with /waia.
DescriptionJapanese: サーバー情報付近に現在地のゾーン・地域・テリトリー名を表示します。/waia で設定します。

Name: Where's my mouse
PunchlineSource: Allows you to not lose track of your mouse on the screen
PunchlineJapanese: マウスカーソル位置を見失わないよう強調します。
DescriptionSource:
Add UI element on top of the mouse like circle to keep track of your mouse location during gameplay.
Open settings with /wmm
DescriptionJapanese: カーソルの周囲に円などのUIを重ねて表示し、戦闘中でもマウス位置を見つけやすくします。

Name: Which Mount
PunchlineSource: Shows what mount another player is using. Includes a mount database, chat links, and trial totem tracking.
PunchlineJapanese: 他プレイヤーが使っているマウントを調べます。
DescriptionSource:
Shows information about mounts other players are using.

Features:
- 'Find Mount' in a player's context menu: shows their mount and how to get it.
- Mount name and unlock status in the target tooltip.
- Mount database with search, expansion filter and acquisition info.
- Trial mount tracks with totem counts (inventory, saddlebag, retainers).
- Chat links: click a mount or totem icon to link it in chat, jump back from any link via 'Open in WhichMount'.
DescriptionJapanese: 対象プレイヤーのマウント名・情報を表示し、マウントDB、チャットリンク、右クリック検索などを提供します。

Name: Which Patch Was That?
PunchlineSource: Quickly check the patch an item was released in!
PunchlineJapanese: アイテム実装パッチをツールチップに表示します。
DescriptionSource:
Whenever you mouseover an item, the tooltip will show you the patch the item was released in.
Never carry around old useless crafting materials again!
DescriptionJapanese: アイテムへマウスオーバーすると、そのアイテムが追加されたパッチ番号を表示します。

Name: Who am I again?
PunchlineSource: Ever forget who you are? We can fix that!
PunchlineJapanese: 現在キャラクター名をサーバー情報バーへ表示します。
DescriptionSource: Shows who you are in the server info bar.
DescriptionJapanese: 複数キャラ運用時などに、自分が今どのキャラクターでログインしているか常時表示します。

Name: Who Did That?
PunchlineSource: Actively logs healing, cleanses, buffs, and more. Finally figure out who rescued you.
PunchlineJapanese: 回復・蘇生・バフ等を誰が行ったか記録します。
DescriptionSource:
This plugin can track the following actions:
- Rescues
- Healing actions
- Status/Buff Application
- Cleanses 
- Heals
- Mitigation
- Provoke
- Shirk

These will be logged in your chat when they are used on your character.
DescriptionJapanese: 救出、回復、ステータス付与、エスナ、蘇生などをログ化し、誰が行ったか後から確認できます。

Name: Wholist
PunchlineSource: Show nearby players in a stylish way, inspired by the "/who" command from World of Warcraft.
PunchlineJapanese: 周囲プレイヤーをWoW /who風に一覧表示します。
DescriptionSource:
Show nearby players in a stylish way, inspired by the "/who" command from World of Warcraft

Features:
- Minimalistic interface that can be scaled down to become part of your HUD.
- Player context menu items for examining, searching on the Lodestone and more.
- Customizable colours & behaviour.
- Random adventure plate command
- Display nearby player count in the server info bar

Please note this plugin will automatically disable functionality in PvP.
DescriptionJapanese: 近くのプレイヤーをコンパクトで見やすい一覧にし、各種情報を表示します。

Name: Who's Talking
PunchlineSource: See Discord voice activity indicators directly on your party list.
PunchlineJapanese: Discord通話中の発言者をPTリストへ表示します。
DescriptionSource:
Once installed, join a Discord voice channel and an XIV party, and have people put their character names in their Discord nicknames (or configure things manually in the plugin settings). You should get colourful outlines around the job icons on the party list: green for talking, blue for muted, red for deafened, and yellow for unknown name.

Note that you'll get a permission prompt mentioning "StreamKit Overlay" – this is expected.

Some icons by Google, Apache 2.0.
DescriptionJapanese: DiscordボイスチャンネルとFFXIVパーティを対応付け、現在話しているメンバーのインジケーターをPTリストに表示します。

Name: Wikilinx Rightclicks
PunchlineSource: FFXIV Wiki and Eorzea DB context menu integration
PunchlineJapanese: 右クリックからFFXIV Wiki／エオルゼアDBを開きます。
DescriptionSource: Never forget how to get an item again! Just right-click, and *gobbie-BOOM!* Integrates with any community wiki as well as the official Eorzea DB.
DescriptionJapanese: アイテム等のコンテキストメニューへ外部Wiki・公式DB検索を追加し、入手方法などを素早く調べられます。

Name: Window Title Changer
PunchlineSource: Change your game window titie
PunchlineJapanese: FFXIVウィンドウのタイトル文字列を変更します。
DescriptionSource: Allows you to change your game window title
DescriptionJapanese: ゲームウィンドウのタイトルバー表示を好きな文字列へ変更できます。

Name: ezWondrousTails
PunchlineSource: Adds row probabilities to the Wondrous Tails display.
PunchlineJapanese: クロの空想帳の1列完成確率を表示します。
DescriptionSource: This plugin prints the probability of getting a row in Wondrous Tails to the in-game display along with the average probability of what would happen if you shuffled.
DescriptionJapanese: 現在配置から1列以上そろう確率や期待値を空想帳画面へ追加表示します。

Name: Wordsmith
PunchlineSource: A roleplay thesaurus and scratch pad.
PunchlineJapanese: RP向け文章作成メモ・類語辞典です。
DescriptionSource: Wordsmith is a text editor with roleplayers in mind. It automatically breaks your text up for easy copy/paste, has advanced features, spellcheck, and even a thesaurus.
DescriptionJapanese: ロールプレイ文章を作成しやすいエディタで、コピーしやすい文分割や文章支援機能を提供します。

Name: Workshop Optimizer Plugin
PunchlineSource: Optimize Island Sanctuary Workshop orders.
PunchlineJapanese: 無人島工房の製品スケジュールを最適化します。
DescriptionSource: Use /wso after you visited your island.
DescriptionJapanese: 無人島へ行った後 /wso を使い、工房の注文組み合わせを最適化します。

Name: Wrath Combo
PunchlineSource: Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button - and then some.
PunchlineJapanese: コンボ・排他アクションを1ボタンへまとめます。
DescriptionSource: Turns one action into many! Similar to how PvP actions work, we take an action and build a whole combo out of it. Sometimes it's as simple as a 1-2-3 combo, other times it's a full job rotation. Either way, you'll find something suited for your rotation needs.
DescriptionJapanese: PvPアクションのように1つのボタンを状況に応じて別アクションへ置き換え、コンボやジョブ操作を簡略化します。

Name: WTSync
PunchlineSource: View a list of all the Wondrous Tails duties shared by your party.
PunchlineJapanese: PTメンバーのクロの空想帳対象を共有します。
DescriptionSource: WTSync keeps uses an external server to keep track of the duties in your Wondrous Tails book. When you're in a party, and other players in the party are also using WTSync, you can open a UI to see which duties everyone needs at once in one convenient list.
DescriptionJapanese: 外部サーバーを使って各メンバーの空想帳対象コンテンツを共有し、パーティ内で共通する対象を一覧表示します。

Name: WukLamark
PunchlineSource: Create custom map markers on the map/minimap! Like <flag> but permanent.
PunchlineJapanese: 地図／ミニマップへ永続カスタムマーカーを追加します。
DescriptionSource:
Allows players to create and manage persistent custom map markers across Eorzea. Whether it's a favorite GPose spot, a venue you want to revisit, or any interesting location, WukLamark lets you drop a map marker that appears seamlessly on both your main map and minimap.

Features:
- Customizable game icons and shapes for map markers (with optional icon tinting).
- Custom map marker icons.
   > To add a custom icon, open the WukLamark window and click on 'Upload a new custom icon'.
- Per-marker icon/shape sizes.
- Organize map markers into groups (with map marker import/export).
- Cross-character sharing configurations.
- Crossworld markers.
- Add personal notes for context.
- Import/export one or multiple map markers with friends.
- Templates for quick map marker creation with predefined properties.

Think of it as dropping a flag on the map but persistent.
DescriptionJapanese: お気に入り撮影場所や採集地点など、通常の<flag>より長く残る独自マーカーをエオルゼア各地へ保存できます。

Name: XIVChat Server
PunchlineSource: Use chat away from the game.
PunchlineJapanese: ゲーム外端末からFFXIVチャットを利用するサーバーです。
DescriptionSource:
XIVChat is a suite of software allowing you to use FFXIV's chat from
different devices. This is the server component required to do so.

For information about clients to use with this server, see the website.
DescriptionJapanese: XIVChatクライアントと接続し、別PCやスマートフォン等からゲーム内チャットを送受信するためのサーバー側プラグインです。

Name: XIV Combo
PunchlineSource: PvP, but in PvE!
PunchlineJapanese: PvEコンボを1ボタン化します。
DescriptionSource: This plugin condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button. /pcombo to open menu
DescriptionJapanese: PvPのように連続コンボや排他アクションを同じホットバーボタンへまとめます。/pcombo で設定します。

Name: The Great Controller HUD Switcher
PunchlineSource: Toggle controller / mouse mode automatically or with commands.
PunchlineJapanese: キーボード／コントローラーHUDを自動切替します。
DescriptionSource: A simple tool to automatically switch between keyboard and controller hud's when pressing WASD or moving the left joystick. You can setup a macro to add the actions to your hotbar.
DescriptionJapanese: WASDや左スティック入力などを検出して操作モードに合うHUDへ自動変更し、コマンドから手動切替もできます。

Name: XIVDeck
PunchlineSource: Turn your Elgato Stream Deck into a hotbar!
PunchlineJapanese: Elgato Stream Deckをゲーム用ホットバーとして使います。
DescriptionSource:
This plugin allows players to use an Elgato Stream Deck as a virtual utility hot bar. Actions are called directly, meaning there is no need to set up awkward keybinds, custom macros, or any other settings.

Note that the XIVDeck Stream Deck plugin must also be installed for this plugin to be useful. You can download the Stream Deck plugin from the linked GitHub repository, under the "Releases" section.

Please report all problems to KazWolfe#2896 in the Dalamud Support server or by opening an Issue on GitHub.
DescriptionJapanese: Stream Deck上のボタンからFFXIVアクションや各種操作を直接実行できる仮想ホットバー連携です。

Name: Fatal Frame
PunchlineSource: Takes a screenshot upon death (and other events).
PunchlineJapanese: 死亡など特定イベント時に自動スクリーンショットを撮ります。
DescriptionSource: Takes a screenshot upon death (and other events).
DescriptionJapanese: 死亡を含む設定イベントが発生した瞬間にゲーム画面を自動撮影します。

Name: XivGearExport
PunchlineSource: A simple utility that allows easy export of your gearsets to xivgear.app.
PunchlineJapanese: ギアセットをxivgear.appへ簡単に出力します。
DescriptionSource:
A plugin that allows easy export of your gearsets to xivgear.app in edit or view mode. Also includes the ability to export your gearsets from the gearset list.

Use /xivgearexport or /xge to export your current gear set.
DescriptionJapanese: 現在の装備構成をxivgear.appの編集／閲覧用形式へエクスポートし、装備比較や共有へ使えます。

Name: XIVJitterFix
PunchlineSource: Fixes SquareEnix' botched antialiasing implementation
PunchlineJapanese: FFXIVのアンチエイリアスによるジッターを軽減します。
DescriptionSource:
With the release of 7.0 SquareEnix has implemented several temporal antialiasing solutions. However they all have a severe bug that affects image quality significantly.
This plugin will restore using jitter when talking to NPCs or in cutscenes and gpose. Jitter (not noticeable micromovements of the camera) is necessary for temporal antialiasing solutions (DLSS, DLAA, TSCMAA+jitter) to work properly.
For some reason, SquareEnix decided we don't need jitter during the time where the game benefits from using it the most.
DescriptionJapanese: 7.0以降のTAA系実装で発生する画面揺れ・にじみなどを補正する描画改善プラグインです。

Name: XIVLogger
PunchlineSource: Save chat logs to your computer as text files or copy them!
PunchlineJapanese: チャットログをテキスト保存・コピーします。
DescriptionSource: Save chat logs as text files from when this is loaded. /xivlogger for settings, /savelog to save logs, /copylogs to copy logs.
DescriptionJapanese: 読み込み後のチャットをファイルへ保存し、/xivlogger、/savelog、/copylogs 等で設定・出力できます。

Name: XIV Uncombo
PunchlineSource: Splits combos into more button for more button bloating. Requires BLU spells.
PunchlineJapanese: 1ボタン化されたコンボを複数ボタンへ分離します。
DescriptionSource: This plugin splits combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto several buttons. For example, a 1-1-1 combo would become 1-2-3.
DescriptionJapanese: コンボや排他アクションをあえて複数ボタンへ分け、各段階を個別に押せるようにします。青魔法が必要です。

Name: XIVWindowResizer
PunchlineSource: Game window resizing plugin. Ever wanted to take 8K screenshots on 144p screen? Now you can.
PunchlineJapanese: ゲームウィンドウを任意解像度へ変更します。
DescriptionSource:
Set your game window to arbitrary size not limited by your display resolution. Mostly useful for taking high-resolution screenshots without going fullscreen and using DSR/FSR.
Requires borderless or windowed mode.
DescriptionJapanese: モニター解像度を超えるサイズも含めFFXIVウィンドウを自由に変更し、高解像度スクリーンショット等に利用できます。

Name: YesAlready
PunchlineSource: Clicks Yes in various dialogs you've specified.
PunchlineJapanese: 指定ダイアログの「はい」を自動クリックします。
DescriptionSource: Tired of clicking yes in Praetorium? Can't stand using keys in dungeons? Well do I have the plugin for you! Yes Already is specifically designed to click all the annoying dialogs you've grown accustomed facerolling. Just enter the dialog text, and you'll never see it again! Also works with /regex/ and has several built-in modules for dialogs that aren't quite yes/no prompts but act like it (like desynth).
DescriptionJapanese: 頻繁に出る確認ダイアログを条件登録し、Yes／確認操作を自動化して繰り返しクリックを減らします。

Name: Yo-kai Check
PunchlineSource: Tracking assistant for Yo-kai Watch rewards.
PunchlineJapanese: 妖怪ウォッチコラボ報酬を追跡します。
DescriptionSource:
Yo-kai Check is a small plugin to assist you in tracking the rewards of the Yo-kai Watch event.
It can be opened with /yokai and shows a list of minions, weapons and how many medals you still need.
When you have a minion summoned, the amount of medals you have and need for the weapon is displayed in the Server Info Bar.
DescriptionJapanese: 妖怪ウォッチイベントのミニオン・武器など報酬の取得状況を管理します。

Name: ZDs
PunchlineSource: ZeeDees, bring the Zs to your Ds!
PunchlineJapanese: リキャスト完了を分かりやすく通知します。
DescriptionSource: Show when cooldowns come off cooldown in an intuitive way!
DescriptionJapanese: 重要アクションが再使用可能になったタイミングを直感的な表示で知らせます。

Name: ZodiacBuddy
PunchlineSource: Complete your Zodiac relic with style.
PunchlineJapanese: ゾディアックウェポン作成を支援します。
DescriptionSource: This plugin attempts to help you complete your Zodiac weapon in various ways.
DescriptionJapanese: 新生のゾディアックウェポンについて、各段階の作業や必要情報を追跡・補助します。

Name: ZodiacBuddy Reborn
PunchlineSource: Finally a reason to open your Relic Book on purpose!
PunchlineJapanese: 新生レリック各工程を自動化・支援します。
DescriptionSource: Automates various steps of the ARR Relic Quests
DescriptionJapanese: ARRレリッククエストの本・討伐など複数工程を自動化し、ゾディアックウェポン作成を楽にします。
